rationale: The short thesis is intact — price holds below both VWAP ($42.21) and the 5m 9-EMA ($40.70), the bounce to $40.84 was rejected on the heaviest volume of the consolidation (58k shares), and lower highs are now pressing the $40.13 day low whose break opens the unfilled gap toward $38.89. The 20-minute coil just above the low is the main squeeze risk, but every bounce has been sold with no buy-side absorption, so I hold for the $40.13 trigger rather than paying the spread to exit or flipping into a long that fights the prevailing structure.
